hotspots.title: Meloni-Modi alliance reshapes Italy-India ties
hotspots.blurb: Italy and India elevated their relationship to a 'Special Strategic Partnership' during PM Narendra Modi's visit to Rome. The leaders signed agreements targeting €20 billion in trade by 2029, focusing on defense, AI, critical minerals, and maritime security. The visit included symbolic gestures like planting a mulberry tree and sharing 'Melody' candies, referencing their viral 'Melodi' meme.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high-profile nature of the diplomatic upgrade, the symbolic gestures reinforcing personal rapport, and the strategic economic and geopolitical stakes involved.

hotspots.title: La Libertad Avanza internal power struggles
hotspots.blurb: Argentina's ruling party, La Libertad Avanza, is embroiled in internal conflicts involving key figures like Manuel Adorni, Santiago Caputo, Martín Menem, and Karina Milei. Allegations of illicit enrichment, fabricated controversies, and public spats dominate the discourse, with President Javier Milei attempting to mediate but facing mounting pressure from judicial investigations and public protests.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high-stakes political infighting, moral panic over corruption allegations, and the potential impact on Argentina's economic and political stability.

hotspots.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) continues to gain traction in polls, leading with 28-29% support nationally and up to 42% in Saxony-Anhalt. The party faces internal power struggles, legal challenges over its extremist classification, and debates over its potential to govern. Key figures like Alice Weidel and Björn Höcke are central to the discourse.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the alarmist framing around the AfD's rise, polarized contention over its extremist classification, and the high stakes of its potential governance in Germany.

hotspots.title: Reform UK’s local election breakthrough
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK made significant gains in local elections across the UK, becoming the main opposition in several councils. The party's success is fueled by voter dissatisfaction with mainstream parties, particularly over immigration and economic issues. Controversies over candidate selections and past statements have also dominated coverage.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the alarmist framing around Reform UK's rise, polarized contention over its policies, and the high stakes of its potential impact on UK politics.
